Page No.# 2/3 Before Hon'Ble Mrs. Justice Susmita Phukan Khaund 20.02.2023
1.

Heard Mr. D. Sarmah, learned counsel appearing for the petitioners as well as Mr. B.B. Gogoi,
learned Addl. P.P. appearing for the State respondent.

2. This application under Section 439 Cr.P.C, is preferred by the petitioners, namely, Kiyamat Ali
and Tuta Miya @ Gatu Miya, who are languishing in judicial custody since 26.11.2022, in connection
with Prc Case No. 1356/2022, Tarabari Police station case No. 15/2022, registered under Section
506/120(B)/341/307/326/379/34 Ipc.
Page No.# 1/3 vs The State Of Assam on 20 February, 2023

1

3.
It is submitted that the charge-sheet has been laid against the petitioners as well as the co-accused persons under the aforesaid sections of law.
It is submitted that the petitioners will co-operate with the trial.
The co-accused persons are shown as absconders.
In case of delay of appearance of the accused persons shown as absconders, the petitioners will suffer as trial is yet to commence.
4. It is submitted that the incarceration of the petitioners will tantamount to curtailment of personal liberty in case trial is procrastinated due to the absence of the absconding accused persons.
5. I have considered the submissions at the Bar and I have perused the scanned copies of the LCR.
The petitioners have pledged to co-operate with the trial.
Considering all aspects and in view of my foregoing discussions, the petition is allowed.

6. The petitioners are to be enlarged on bail of Rs. 50,000/- each with a suitable surety each of like amount to the satisfaction of learned SDJM(S), Barpeta, Page No.# 3/3 under the conditions that:-
(i) the petitioners will co-operate with the investigation and will not exercise threats to the witnesses, This petition stands disposed of.
Send back the case diary.
